result_summary.title: CRITICAL: Data residency mismatch and missing consent in Payment Gateway v2
result_summary.description: We are experiencing a critical issue with Payment Gateway v2 in APAC production. Approximately 1826 users are affected by a data residency flag mismatch, and their consent records are missing. This poses a significant compliance risk. The gateway is processing payments but failing to tag the jurisdiction correctly or retain the consent artifacts. Immediate resolution is required.
